tiers.official: Government, military, ministry, or state news agency speaking for the named country/actor. Leads every answer.
tiers.semi_official: State-linked / IRGC-linked / Houthi-linked outlets and channels — where claims surface first; NOT a government statement.
tiers.media: Credible named news outlets, reached on demand via Bing News RSS. Unofficial but accountable.

transports.telegram: Telegram API (Telethon) when TELEGRAM_API_ID/HASH set + logged in (tools/telegram_login.py); t.me/s/ web preview fallback. Actor primary sources + vetted journalists.
transports.x: X/Twitter API v2 recent-search by account. Requires X_BEARER_TOKEN; inactive until set.
transports.bing: Bing News RSS query — retrieves this body's statements via wire/media relay with direct article links.
transports.rss: Native RSS feed of the source itself.

transport_policy.rule: ONLY Telegram + X + Bing News RSS are intel transports. The per-outlet media RSS pile and all dead web-scrape sources were removed.
kept_by_exception: IRNA / Press TV (official Iran) + Mehr (semi-official) native RSS — Iran's own primary voice, live-verified returning on-target intel; Bing relay of Iranian state media is slower and loses their framing.
Tzeva Adom API (Israel Home Front Command siren mirror) — the only structured source for Israeli sirens/impact/timing and for genuine all-quiet reporting; no Telegram/X/Bing source replaces it.
US State Dept travel advisories RSS — single low-noise official feed; covers embassy/consular suspensions (EXAMPLES #3).
transport_policy.note: These three exceptions are flagged for the user to cut if unwanted.

rules: Official sources from BOTH Iran and the target countries are prioritized and must always be present in output; then semi-official, then media.
LOCATION IS MANDATORY on every intel item: city, facility/base name, coordinates, or source-stated distance to a named city/airport. No internal asset codes.
Bing News queries MUST stay simple (1-3 words + country/agency name); complex boolean queries degrade to noise. Several small queries + dedupe beats one big query.

A body retrieved via `bing` is being read through MEDIA RELAY, not from the agency directly: items are marked retrieval='bing_news_relay' and must be attributed as 'official statement, via media relay'.
MEDIA tier = Bing News across credible named outlets ONLY. No anonymous OSINT/Telegram aggregators — removed 2026-07-16 as not credible.
Actor official/semi-official Telegram + X channels are PRIMARY SOURCES in their own tier, not the media tier.
Telegram/X handles get renamed/banned — re-probe regularly; verified=false means unreachable/unprobed at last check, not necessarily dead.

RELAY RELEVANCE GATE: a bing-routed article must mention one of that body's relevance_terms in its title or it is discarded. Bing returns articles MATCHING a query, not the agency's statements — without this gate, unrelated coverage gets attributed to a government body.

RELAY FRESHNESS: bing sources default to a 24h window; low-volume advisory bodies (UKMTO, MARAD, NetBlocks, INCD, aeCERT, Nour, Saba, Al Masirah) use relay_freshness='week' — verified 2026-07-16 that 'UKMTO' returns 0 at day and 4 real advisories at week. Their advisories stay operative until withdrawn, so the wider window is correct, not stale. Timestamps are always shown so age is never hidden.

TRANSPORT LADDER (enforced): X is EXPLICIT-REQUEST-ONLY. ALL X sources are on_demand_only=true, so auto-batch collection NEVER fetches X — default answers use Telegram + Bing relay + RSS only. get_x_account is called ONLY when the user explicitly asks for X/Twitter or for 'the official source'. This caps X credit spend to deliberate asks.
